sample_unit: questionnaire respondents (81 surgeons and 53 patients) rating ChatGPT answers to 220 patient questions

links.outcome: Readability (Flesch-Kincaid Grade Level) of ChatGPT responses versus patient education level
links.effect: FKGL readability scores of ChatGPT responses were high, so understanding requires a high level of education; patients' mean education was 4.8th grade.
links.quote: The FKGL readability scores of the ChatGPT responses were high.

screen.reason: The study evaluates ChatGPT-3.5's responses to real patient questions regarding total knee arthroplasty using surveys of surgeons and patients along with readability scoring, but does not test a specific deployment practice or safeguard.
